user.title: Findus Internet-OPAC library account
user.description: Connect a library card of a library that uses Findus Internet-OPAC. The subdomain is the part before .findus-internet-opac.de, for example alzey.

data_description.account_name: Display name for this card, e.g. a family member's name.
data_description.subdomain: For example alzey. A full Findus URL is accepted too.
data_description.card: The reader number (Leserkonto) printed next to the barcode on the library card.
data_description.secret: Birth date as DD.MM.YYYY or your password, exactly as on the library website.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The library rejected the stored birth date or password for {account_name}. Enter the current one.

data_description.secret: Birth date as DD.MM.YYYY or your password, exactly as on the library website.

error.invalid_auth: Card number or birth date/password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Findus site of this library.
error.invalid_subdomain: Not a valid Findus subdomain. Use the part before .findus-internet-opac.de, e.g. alzey.

abort.already_configured: This library card is already configured.

data_description.scan_hours: Hours between account checks. Findus is only refreshed by the library a few times a day.
data_description.due_soon_days: Items due within this many days count as due soon.
data_description.auto_renew: Automatically request renewal for items that can be renewed and are due soon.
data_description.auto_renew_days: Renew items due within this many days (0 = only on the due date).
data_description.auto_renew_categories: Restrict auto-renew to these media types. Nothing selected = all types.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify services to send to, e.g. mobile_app_my_phone. Nothing selected = notifications off.
data_description.notify_time: Daily time for the due-date digest.
data_description.notify_events: Due soon and due today are sent once per item, overdue once a day, renewals when they happen, card expiry 30 and 7 days ahead.

renew_auth_failed.message: Renewal failed: the library rejected the stored credentials.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Findus account with config entry ID {config_entry_id}.

notify_card.message: Library card valid until {date} – please have it renewed

notify_card_expired.message: Library card expired on {date} – please have it renewed

renew.name: Renew loans
renew.description: Submit a renewal request for library items. Findus treats this as a renewal request; the new due date may only show after the library's next sync.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the library account.

media_ids.name: Media IDs
media_ids.description: Media numbers to renew (the mednr attribute of an item). Leave empty to renew everything currently renewable.

categories.name: Media types
categories.description: Only renew items of these media types. Combined with media IDs if both are given.
